repairs.quote: Tap: Warwick lunges forward and bites, dealing ((120% Attack Damage) + (100% Ability Power)) plus 6/7/8/9/10% max Health magic damage and healing for 25/37.5/50/62.5/75% of the damage dealt. Hold: Warwick lunges and clamps his jaws on the target, leaping behind them. While clamped, Warwick follows all movement of the target. After releasing his hold, he does the same damage and healing. This Ability applies On-Hit and On-Attack effects, and does not Critically Strike. While clamped, Warwick is immune to displacement.
